caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate object resembling a decorative pedestal or base, possibly part of a candlestick or architectural element. The object is centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background with no other items or scenery. Its structure consists of a round base supporting a bulbous body that tapers upward to a cylindrical neck and flat, circular top. The base is roughly octagonal and features angular geometric patterns in shades of golden brown and yellow, with subtle, faded red and white detailing. The main body of the object exhibits an uneven surface texture with similar golden yellow and tan hues, interspersed with patches of gray, brown, and faint red. The cylindrical neck and top are rendered in a reddish-brown color, distinct from the rest of the body. Shadows and highlights suggest the object is made of wood or a metal with a patina. The bottom right of the drawing bears the artist's signature, "EDWARD T. JEWETT."
title: Candlestick (Ecclesiastical)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
